steps.text: During adolescence the body grows very fast — this is called the growth spurt. Let's look at it.
Watch how height and weight increase quickly over these years, faster than in childhood.
Arms and legs often grow first, so this fast growth can feel a bit awkward — that's completely normal.
Everyone grows at their own pace and stops at different times. Good food, sleep and exercise support healthy growth.
